scope: Disposable kind Kubernetes v1.36.1 cluster. Tests namespace-scoped Deployment authorization with a short-lived fixture ServiceAccount token, then a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy parameterized by a protected namespace-local ConfigMap promotion record. Deployments have zero replicas and inert images.

checks.claim: API authenticates the caller as the enrolled fixture ServiceAccount
Before admission policy, a release-authorized principal can submit an unapproved promotion reference
Admission rejects the same unapproved promotion reference in the release namespace
checks.observed: The deployments "baseline-wrong-promotion" is invalid: : ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'saf-model-promotion-policy' with binding 'saf-model-promotion-binding' denied request: promotion record reference does not match

checks.claim: The authorized principal can create a digest-pinned Deployment matching the protected promotion record
Admission rejects a model ID that differs from the promotion record
checks.observed: The deployments "blocked-wrong-model" is invalid: : ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'saf-model-promotion-policy' with binding 'saf-model-promotion-binding' denied request: model ID does not match the promotion record

checks.claim: Admission rejects an image digest that differs from the promotion record
checks.observed: The deployments "blocked-wrong-digest" is invalid: : ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'saf-model-promotion-policy' with binding 'saf-model-promotion-binding' denied request: model image digest does not match the promotion record

checks.claim: The same principal cannot deploy into the staging namespace without a RoleBinding there
